account.tagline: Set the login that locks this Rome to you. One account, one keeper.
account.errorPasswordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

codexDeviceLogin.title: Sign in with a device code

enable.title: Turn on device code sign-in
enable.body: In ChatGPT, open <settingsLink>Settings → Security</settingsLink> and turn on “Enable device code authorization for Codex.” You only need to do this once.
enable.adminNotice: On ChatGPT Team or Enterprise accounts, this is managed by the admin.

copyCode.title: Copy your device code
copyCode.body: Copy your code and paste it on the verification page to finish.

codexDeviceLogin.connectedBody: You're all set — this window will close automatically.

errors.title: Login could not complete
errors.startFailed: Could not start ChatGPT device login. Try again or use the browser flow.

chatgptLogin.title: Sign in with ChatGPT
chatgptLogin.privacyNote: Your password goes to OpenAI directly. Rome does not see or store it.

notice.title: Sign in to ChatGPT in the browser below
notice.body: Sign into ChatGPT in the browser below. Once you're done, click "I've logged in" to continue.

notice.title: Authorize ChatGPT in the browser below
notice.body: If the page didn't open or something went wrong, hit Retry to relaunch it, or Back to return to the ChatGPT login.

errors.navigateFailed: Could not open the server browser. Use the terminal flow instead.
errors.codexStartFailed: Could not start ChatGPT login. Use the terminal flow instead.
errors.codexExitedWithoutAuth: ChatGPT login closed before completing. Try again or use the terminal flow.
